title: Startup jitter mitigation and selection tuning for FlashAttention v3 prefill paths
creator: Maya Chen
description: Summary: We are seeing intermittent increased tail latency during cold-start/prefill for short-to-medium sequence generation when the runtime selects FlashAttention v3 kernels alongside quantized execution paths. Symptoms include 5-25ms spikes on 99th percentile for sequences <128 tokens in our Canary region. Hypothesis: memory fragmentation and early kernel fallback decisions (tile/strategy mismatch) cause temporary selection of a slower matmul-based fallback; additionally, some int8/quantized kernel warm-up paths cause one-off allocations that block decoding threads. This ticket will build an emulation + telemetry surface, implement mitigations in the kernel selector scoring function, and add warm-start/warm-prefill heuristics to avoid startup jitter.
comments: 2025-02-18 - Maya C: Initial report from canary (us-west-2). 99p increased ~12ms for seq<=64 on model x86-ggml-13b-compat when switching kernels at prefill boundary. Logged kernel_choice and mem_headroom metrics.

2025-02-20 - Rafael O: Reproduced locally on p4dn.xlarge with test harness. Observed slow path 'fallback_matmul_v1' chosen after first decode step when available_free_mem < 420MB. Added microbench that allocates then frees small KV chunks to emulate fragmentation.

2025-02-24 - Priya N: Design note added — propose selector change: add startup_penalty factor for kernels that frequently fallback and prefer warmup routines for quantized kernels. Also propose a 5-run warm-prefill that executes a tiny synthetic token generation to pre-allocate shared buffers.

2025-02-26 - Rafael O: Implemented telemetry tags (kernel_name, selection_reason, mem_headroom_before, mem_headroom_after). Deployed to canary with feature-flag runtime.kernel_startup_warmup=true. Early results: 99p spike reduced from +12ms to +3ms for seq<=64 but cost increased ~0.6% (prefill warmup tokens).
2025-03-01 - Design review: Maya and Priya approved selector change with a follow-up to make warmup adaptive by customer tier. Action: add override to disable warmup for best-effort tenants.

2025-03-03 - Rafael O: Running extended canary (72h) and collecting regressions metrics. Preparing PR to include a safety throttle that reverts to previous selector if overall P50 increases >2ms. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8742
